slides.title: Where does my dog ==*sleep*==?
slides.lead: **With us: a real home.** Real beds. No crates, no kennel rows.

slides.title: How often do they go ==*outside*==?
slides.lead: **Every hour.** Plus supervised pool time on hot Miramar days.

slides.title: How do new dogs ==*meet*== the pack?
slides.lead: **Slowly.** One on one time with us first. The pack when they're ready.

slides.title: What costs ==*extra*==? How will I ==*see*== my dog?
list: **Included:** play, toys and supervised pool time. $60 a day under 50 lb, $75 over.
